en: A vintage black‑and‑white cityscape showing dense mid‑rise buildings near the coastline, with a few trees and palm trees in the foreground. The architecture looks late‑19th to early‑20th century Mediterranean/European style. Printed caption text at the bottom reads "ALEXANDRIA. — West Bay. — LL." and a small serial number "35" on the left. A modern watermark "www.elia.org.gr" is superimposed across the lower right.
